Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: A vastly improved Sperry Corporation AN/APQ-127 radar replaced the AN/APG-46 fire control radar.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: The _____ system was removed and an internal refueling system was added, sometimes supplemented by a D-704 refueling pod on the centerline pylon
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The DIANE system was removed and an internal refueling system was added, sometimes supplemented by a D-704 refueling pod on the centerline pylon.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: Their operation was integrated into the Intruder squadrons, as A-6 crew were trained to operate both aircraft and the _____ covered both the A6 and KA-6D
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: Their operation was integrated into the Intruder squadrons, as A-6 crew were trained to operate both aircraft and the NATOPS covered both the A6 and KA-6D.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: The retirement of the aircraft left a gap in _____ and Marine Corps refueling tanker capability
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The retirement of the aircraft left a gap in US Navy and Marine Corps refueling tanker capability.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: At least 16 KA-6Ds served in the _____
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: At least 16 KA-6Ds served in the Gulf War.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: The Navy Lockheed S-3 _____ filled that gap until the new F/A-18E/F Super Hornet became operational
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The Navy Lockheed S-3 Viking filled that gap until the new F/A-18E/F Super Hornet became operational.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: A new AN/ASN-92 inertial navigation system was added, along with the CAINS (_____), for greater navigation accuracy
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: A new AN/ASN-92 inertial navigation system was added, along with the CAINS (Carrier Aircraft Inertial Navigation System), for greater navigation accuracy.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: TRAM was matched with a new _____ AN/APQ-156 radar
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The earlier separate search and track (fire control) radars of the A-6A/B/C were replaced by a single Norden AN/APQ-148 multi-mode radar, and onboard computers with a more sophisticated (and generally more reliable) IC based system, as opposed to the A-6A's DIANE discrete transistor-based technology. TRAM was matched with a new Norden AN/APQ-156 radar.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: The BN could use both _____ imagery and radar data for extremely accurate attacks, or use the TRAM sensors alone to attack without using the Intruder's radar (which might warn the target)
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: Beginning in 1979, all A-6Es were fitted with the AN/AAS-33 DRS (Detecting and Ranging Set), part of the 'Target Recognition and Attack Multi-Sensor' (TRAM) system, a small, gyroscopically stabilized turret, mounted under the nose of the aircraft, containing a forward-looking infra-red (FLIR) boresighted with a laser spot-tracker/designator and IBM AN/ASQ-155 computer. TRAM was matched with a new Norden AN/APQ-156 radar.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: In addition, the Intruder used an _____ (AMTI), which allowed the aircraft to track a moving target (such as a tank or truck) and drop ordnance on it even though the target was moving
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: In addition, the Intruder used an Airborne Moving Target Indicator (AMTI), which allowed the aircraft to track a moving target (such as a tank or truck) and drop ordnance on it even though the target was moving.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: In the 1980s, the A-6E TRAM aircraft were converted to the A-6E '_____' (WCSI) version to extend weapons capability
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: In the 1980s, the A-6E TRAM aircraft were converted to the A-6E 'Weapons Control System Improvement' (WCSI) version to extend weapons capability.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: This added the ability to carry and target some of the first generation precision guided weapons, like the AGM-84 _____ missile, and AGM-123 Skipper
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: This added the ability to carry and target some of the first generation precision guided weapons, like the AGM-84 Harpoon missile, and AGM-123 Skipper. Since the Harpoon and SLAM missiles had common communication interfaces, WCSI aircraft could carry and fire SLAM missiles, but needed a nearby A-6E SWIP to guide them to target.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: Since the _____ and SLAM missiles had common communication interfaces, WCSI aircraft could carry and fire SLAM missiles, but needed a nearby A-6E SWIP to guide them to target
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: This added the ability to carry and target some of the first generation precision guided weapons, like the AGM-84 Harpoon missile, and AGM-123 Skipper. Since the Harpoon and SLAM missiles had common communication interfaces, WCSI aircraft could carry and fire SLAM missiles, but needed a nearby A-6E SWIP to guide them to target.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: WCSI equipped aircraft were eventually modified to have a limited capability to use the AGM-84E _____ standoff land attack missile
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: WCSI equipped aircraft were eventually modified to have a limited capability to use the AGM-84E SLAM standoff land attack missile. Since the Harpoon and SLAM missiles had common communication interfaces, WCSI aircraft could carry and fire SLAM missiles, but needed a nearby A-6E SWIP to guide them to target.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: A co-processor was added to the AN/ASQ-155 computer system to implement the needed MIL-STD-_____ digital interfaces to the pylons, as well as an additional control panel
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: A co-processor was added to the AN/ASQ-155 computer system to implement the needed MIL-STD-1553 digital interfaces to the pylons, as well as an additional control panel.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: In 1990, the decision was made to terminate production of the A-6.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: The final production order was for 20 aircraft of the SWIP configuration with composite wings, delivered in _____
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The final production order was for 20 aircraft of the SWIP configuration with composite wings, delivered in 1993.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: Although five development aircraft were built, the U.S. Navy ultimately chose not to authorize the A-6F, preferring to concentrate on the A-12 _____ II
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: Although five development aircraft were built, the U.S. Navy ultimately chose not to authorize the A-6F, preferring to concentrate on the A-12 Avenger II.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: This left the service in a quandary when the A-12 was canceled in _____
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: This left the service in a quandary when the A-12 was canceled in 1991.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: An EW version of the Intruder, initially designated A2F-1H (rather than A2F-1Q, as "Q" was being split to relegate it to passive electronic warfare and "H" to active) and subsequently redesignated EA-
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: An EW version of the Intruder, initially designated A2F-1H (rather than A2F-1Q, as "Q" was being split to relegate it to passive electronic warfare and "H" to active) and subsequently redesignated EA-6A, first flew on 26 April 1963.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: It had a _____-Ramo AN/ALQ-86 ECM suite, with most electronics contained on the walnut-shaped pod atop the vertical fin
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: It had a Bunker-Ramo AN/ALQ-86 ECM suite, with most electronics contained on the walnut-shaped pod atop the vertical fin.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: They were equipped with AN/APQ-129 fire control radar, and theoretically capable of firing the AGM-45 Shrike anti-radiation missile, although they were apparently not used in that role.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: Only 28 EA-6As were built (2 prototypes, 15 new-build, and 11 conversions from A-6As), serving with U.S. Marine Corps squadrons in Vietnam.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: It was phased out of front line service in the mid-1970s, remaining in use in reserve VMCJ units with the USMC and then the _____ in specialized VAQ units, primarily for training purposes
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: It was phased out of front line service in the mid-1970s, remaining in use in reserve VMCJ units with the USMC and then the United States Navy in specialized VAQ units, primarily for training purposes.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The last EA-6A had been retired by 1993.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The EA-6B took on the duties of the U.S. Air Force EF-111 Raven when the DoD decided to let the U.S. Navy handle all electronic warfare missions.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The Prowler has been replaced by the EA-18G Growler in the U.S. Navy and was retired from USMC service in 2019.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: A2F-1 First production variant with fixed tailpipe, 484 built, redesignated A-6A in 1962. YA2F-1H Prototype electronic warfare variant, one modified from A2F-1, redesignated YEA-6A in 1962.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: A2F-1 First production variant with fixed tailpipe, 484 built, redesignated A-6A in 1962. YA2F-1H Prototype electronic warfare variant, one modified from A2F-1, redesignated YEA-6A in 1962.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: A2F-1 First production variant with fixed tailpipe, 484 built, redesignated A-6A in 1962. YA2F-1H Prototype electronic warfare variant, one modified from A2F-1, redesignated YEA-6A in 1962.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations

Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: Can also carry the AGM-84 Harpoon.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: The A-_____ was the first U.S. Navy aircraft to have an integrated airframe and weapons system
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The A-6 was the first U.S. Navy aircraft to have an integrated airframe and weapons system. On 19 April 1960, the first prototype made its maiden flight; the type was introduced to squadron service during February 1963.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: The A-6 was operated by both the U.S. Navy and U.S. _____ as their principal all-weather/night attack aircraft between 1963 and 1997, during which time multiple variants were developed and introduced
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The A-6 was operated by both the U.S. Navy and U.S. Marine Corps as their principal all-weather/night attack aircraft between 1963 and 1997, during which time multiple variants were developed and introduced.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: Following evaluation of the bids, the U.S. Navy announced the selection of Grumman on 2 _____ 1958

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: Extending the air brakes, which were mounted on the rear fuselage, changed the downwash at the horizontal tailplane which overloaded its actuator so the tailplane was moved rearwards by _____ (41 cm)
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: Extending the air brakes, which were mounted on the rear fuselage, changed the downwash at the horizontal tailplane which overloaded its actuator so the tailplane was moved rearwards by 16 inches (41 cm).

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: The last variant to be produced was the A-_____E, first introduced in 1972; it features extensive avionics improvements, including the new APQ-148 multimode radar, along with minor airframe refinement
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: Various specialized variants of the A-6 were developed, often in response to urgent military requirements raised during the Vietnam War. The A-6C, a dedicated interdictor, was one such model, as was the KA-6D, a buddy store-equipped aerial refueling tanker.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: A-_____ Intruders first saw action during the Vietnam War, where the craft were used extensively against targets in Vietnam
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: The first operational fleet squadron, VA-75 re-equipped with A-6s from October 1963. The A-6 became both the U.S. Navy's and U.S. Marine Corps's principal medium and all-weather/night attack aircraft from the mid-1960s through the 1990s and as an aerial tanker either in the dedicated KA-6D version or by use of a buddy store (D-704).

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: On 19 April 1988, VA-95 _____ operating from USS Enterprise sank the Iranian frigate, Sahand and severely damaged the Iranian frigate, Sabalan during Operation Praying Mantis
Grumman A-6 Intruder.fact: Intruders also saw action in April 1986 operating from the aircraft carriers USS America and Coral Sea during the bombing of Libya (Operation El Dorado Canyon). On 19 October 1987, Intruders of VA-145 operating from USS Ranger attacked Iranian oil platforms during Operation Nimble Archer.

Grumman A-6 Intruder.subject: International Relations
Grumman A-6 Intruder.question: This added the ability to carry and target some of the first generation precision guided weapons, like the AGM-_____ Harpoon missile, and AGM-123 Skipper
